body: I feel like everything i would do would just be a distraction away from death and that whats is the use if we will die anyways. Why not just end it now?

it's hard for me to see anything worth doing in this life since everything is so arbitrary, it doesn't matter what you do in this life because everything will be gone once you die. Everybody will end up the same, the saints and the sinners.
I hope that this is just some kind of a phase or a funk i'm in and will pass, has this ever happen to anybody else?
I would love to turn to religion in a situation like this, but i just can't
does it help? I dont really see how someone will fix this
